bpm_buckets.character: Driving Steel / Warehouse Grey — hypnotic mid-tempo groove; long reverb tails on percussion; sparse minimal melody; 4-on-the-floor kick dominates
Peak Hour / Strobe Metal — high-energy peak-hour set; tails tighten by ~9% vs T1; stabs become more industrial and percussive

kick.name: Kick
kick.role: Temporal grid anchor — 4-on-the-floor every beat, relentless pulse

effect_chain.params: 18 Hz, 24 dB/oct Butterworth
Attack +5 dB (0-5 ms), Sustain -3 dB (50-200 ms) — tight, punchy
Ratio 4:1, Thr -12 dBFS, Attack 5 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.5, Knee 2 dB, GR 3-5 dB
Drive +3 dB, Mix 100%, odd-harmonic H3/H5 bias, Target THD 5-8% — industrial edge
Bell -3 dB @350 Hz Q=1.4; Bell +2 dB @60 Hz Q=1.2; Shelf -1 dB @200 Hz
Ceiling -1.0 dBTP, Lookahead 1.5 ms

bass.name: Bass
bass.role: Harmonic root — minimal movement, mono-critical low end for club systems

effect_chain.params: 28 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Ratio 6:1, Thr -15 dBFS, Attack 1 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.75 (dotted-8th), GR 4-6 dB
Drive +4 dB, Mix 100%, Target THD 6-10%, pre-EQ position
Bell -2.5 dB @250 Hz Q=1.2; Low shelf +1.5 dB below 60 Hz
Ratio 3:1, Thr -10 dBFS, Attack 10 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×2, GR 2-3 dB
Side channel entirely muted below 150 Hz — maximum mono compatibility for club sub arrays; Ceiling -8 dBFS

chords.name: Chords
chords.role: Sparse harmonic support — minimalist pad voicings, long decay, industrial texture

effect_chain.params: 150 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Bell -2 dB @800 Hz Q=1.0; Bell -1.5 dB @300 Hz Q=1.2
Ratio 2.5:1, Thr -14 dBFS, Attack 15 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×1 (quarter note), GR 2-3 dB
Width ±20% — narrow, mono-compatible harmonic bed
RT60 3.5 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/16, HPF 300 Hz, LPF 8 kHz, Mix 25% wet — long tail reinforces industrial space
+1 dB high shelf @8 kHz — subtle metallic overtone presence

melody.name: Melody
melody.role: Minimal melodic motif — single-note stabs, sparse, industrial atmosphere

effect_chain.params: 200 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Presence bell +2 dB @3.2 kHz Q=1.8; Bell -2 dB @500 Hz Q=1.5
Ratio 3:1, Thr -13 dBFS, Attack 8 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.75, GR 3-5 dB
Time = 60000/BPM×0.75 (dotted 8th), Feedback 28%, Mix 16%, HPF 400 Hz
RT60 2.0 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/16, HPF 400 Hz, LPF 9 kHz, Mix 18%
Ceiling -8 dBFS; +1.5 dB air shelf @10 kHz

arp.name: Arp
arp.role: Rhythmic modulation / sequencer pattern — mechanical, locked to grid

effect_chain.params: 300 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Attack +3 dB, Sustain -4 dB
Ratio 4:1, Thr -16 dBFS, Attack 2 ms, Release = 60000/BPM/2, GR 3-4 dB
Time = 60000/BPM/4 (16th note), Feedback 35%, Mix 25%, HPF 600 Hz
RT60 0.5 s, Pre-delay 8 ms, HPF 800 Hz, Mix 10%
Width ±60-80% above 500 Hz, mono below 300 Hz; Ceiling -8 dBFS

pads.name: Pads
pads.role: Industrial spatial floor — long decaying texture, wide, non-melodic atmosphere

effect_chain.params: 220 Hz, 6 dB/oct
Ratio 2:1, Thr -18 dBFS, Attack 30 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×4, GR 2-3 dB
RT60 5.0 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/8, HPF 300 Hz, Mix 35% — industrial cave ambience
Ratio 3:1, Thr -22 dBFS, Attack 5 ms, Release = 60000/BPM, GR 3-4 dB
Width 150% above 300 Hz, Correlation floor +0.2; Output limiter -12 dBFS

stabs.name: Stabs
stabs.owns: Mid 500 Hz-2 kHz + High-mid 2-6 kHz transients
stabs.role: Industrial accent — metallic hit, percussive punctuation, sparse duty cycle

effect_chain.params: 250 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Attack +5 dB, Sustain -6 dB — hard, sharp accent
Ratio 5:1, Thr -14 dBFS, Attack 3 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.5, GR 5-8 dB
Drive +4 dB, Mix 60%, H3/H5 dominant — metallic industrial character
RT60 0.4 s, Gate hold 120 ms, Pre-delay 5 ms, HPF 500 Hz, Mix 8%
+2 dB @2.5 kHz Q=1.6; -3 dB @400 Hz Q=2.0; Ceiling -7 dBFS

fx.name: FX
fx.owns: Air 6-20 kHz + broadband sweeps + industrial noise
fx.role: Transition, industrial noise texture & tension build

effect_chain.params: Swept 20 Hz -> 2 kHz over riser duration, 12 dB/oct
Width ramps ±40% -> ±100%
Time = 60000/BPM×0.75 (dotted 8th), Feedback 40%, Mix 30%
RT60 7.0 s, Pre-delay 0 ms, HPF 500 Hz, Mix 50%, freeze on last 1/4 — cavernous techno reverb
Ceiling -1.5 dBTP; LPF 16 kHz 12 dB/oct

percussion.name: Percussion
percussion.role: Hi-hats, claps, metallic shakers — minimal, mechanical groove texture

effect_chain.params: 500 Hz, 18 dB/oct
Attack +2 dB, Sustain -2 dB
Ratio 3:1, Thr -17 dBFS, Attack 1 ms, Release = 60000/BPM/4 (16th note), GR 2-3 dB
-2 dB @6.3 kHz Q=2.5; +2 dB @12 kHz shelf; -1.5 dB @900 Hz Q=1.2
Width ±50%
RT60 0.6 s, Pre-delay 5 ms, HPF 1 kHz, Mix 12%
Ceiling -8 dBFS

intro.name: Intro
intro.owns: First 16 bars, full spectrum, low density
intro.role: Tension-building minimalist statement — bass enters first, kick locked in by bar 4

effect_chain.params: Starts at 800 Hz, sweeps down to 40 Hz over the intro's bar length, 6 dB/oct
RT60 5.0 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/8, HPF 300 Hz, Mix 40% — expansive warehouse space
Width ramps ±60% -> ±100% across intro
Slow LP sweep, Rate = 1/(4 bars × 60/BPM×4) Hz
-24 dB -> 0 dB logarithmic over 16 bars (entry order: Bass -> Kick -> Hi-hat/Percussion -> Pads)
Ceiling -14 dBFS

drum.chain: EQ -> Comp (glue 2:1) -> Saturation (tape, low drive) -> Limiter (-3 dBTP)

bass.chain: HPF (28 Hz) -> Comp (glue 3:1) -> M/S mono-izer (<150 Hz) -> Saturation (tube)

synth.chain: EQ (carve) -> Comp (bus glue 2:1) -> Stereo widener -> Saturation (light, optional)

fx.chain: EQ (notch low-end) -> Delay/Reverb sends -> Limiter (-1.5 dBTP)

master.chain: Bus EQ (±1.5 dB max) -> Multiband glue comp (1.5:1) -> M/S mastering EQ -> True-peak limiter

parallel_compression.reasoning: Techno's 4-on-the-floor kick requires 40-55% wet blend with 1-3 ms attack and 60-100 ms release (per PDF spec); high compression ratio on parallel bus glues the constant kick pattern while preserving the defined transient peak that drives club systems.

kick.exclusive_claim: 50-70 Hz peak; no other track may boost here.

bass.exclusive_claim: 80-200 Hz mono only; notched at kick f0; zero stereo content below 150 Hz.

chords.exclusive_claim: 250-500 Hz; sparse, long-tail voicing; root above 250 Hz mandatory.

melody.exclusive_claim: 800 Hz-2 kHz; minimal note count; priority claim.

arp.exclusive_claim: 2-6 kHz sequenced pattern; notched at melody presence peak.

pads.exclusive_claim: Side channel only; mid deeply scooped at 1-2 kHz.

fx.exclusive_claim: Above 6 kHz; industrial noise; never simultaneous with riser.

percussion.exclusive_claim: Hats and metallic clicks above 2 kHz; -2 dB at 6.3 kHz.

intro.exclusive_claim: First 16 bars only; extreme low density; kick enters at bar 4 minimum.

streaming.notes: Techno typically masters at -14 LUFS; PLR 6-8 dB reflects high average energy density; avoid over-limiting the kick transient — it degrades the club-system impact.

broadcast.notes: EBU R128 ±0.5 LU tolerance. Check mono compatibility rigorously — techno's mono bass must translate perfectly to broadcast mono downmix.

sync_licensing.notes: Stems mandatory. Separate kick/bass stems critical for music editors. Leave dynamic range in — do not target streaming loudness for sync.

branches.kick_desc: Pure sine sub kick, minimal harmonics, instant attack, sub register — primary Techno kick type

bass.avoid: B2+ (centroid drifts into kick critical band)

branches.kick_desc: Analog-modeled kick with moderate harmonic density, instant attack, bass register
Dark, slow-attack sub kick (rare in techno; used for industrial low-tempo variants)

bass.avoid: any A0 R0 (Haas fusion collision with slow kick onset)
